text: The Repair (L-Serine): Your brain makes D-Serine out of L-Serine (Wolosker, et al, 1999). So taking L-Serine gives you more D-serine for that spot on the NMDA receptor, which means a session that ends with the fear down and a sense of mastery has a better chance of sticking. The conversion isn't very efficient though, so some people take D-serine itself instead (more risk, but also more benefit).
reader: someone with trauma or in withdrawal who is anxious, wired, ruminating or raging, wanting to know what is going on in their brain and which of the protocol's tools does what
